nodes.name: Enrich Trigger
nodes.notes: The QuickEnrich lane of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09). Called once per launch with the whole company list; walks it in chunks of 100, hands each chunk to the QuickEnrich chunk worker (its own execution, awaited), accumulates counters, answers the Rootflow. Holds chunk lists and counters only, never a vendor payload, so its memory is flat at any list size.

nodes.name: Chunk Loop
nodes.notes: One chunk at a time. Loop output: the chunk worker, then tick. Done output: the answer.

nodes.name: Call Chunk
nodes.notes: Awaited. One execution per chunk; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted, the lane moves to the next chunk.
